expectations.text: Rules are presented in groups of 3-5, not all at once
expectations.evidence: 5 groups by section (Code Style, CSS, Accessibility, Performance, Architecture), 3 rules each.

expectations.text: Each group shows a table or list with rule, recommended tier, and reasoning
expectations.evidence: Each group has a markdown table with #, Rule, Tier, Reasoning columns.

expectations.text: At least 6 of the Code Style + CSS rules are correctly classified as T1
expectations.evidence: All 6 Code Style + CSS rules classified T1: as-any, export-default, nested-ternary, design-tokens, animation-properties, z-index.

expectations.text: The 'single responsibility' rule is classified as Human (inherently subjective)
expectations.evidence: Classified as Human: inherently subjective, reviewers disagree on responsibility boundaries.

expectations.text: The 'color alone does not convey meaning' rule is T3 visual-qa (requires visual inspection)
expectations.evidence: Classified T3 visual-qa with critical:true for accessibility.

expectations.text: Budget checks run after all blocks are generated
expectations.evidence: Budget check section shows totals after all 5 groups classified.

expectations.text: The total rule count matches the actual number of rules in the file
expectations.evidence: 15 rules total: 8 T1, 1 T2, 5 T3, 1 Human = 15.
